estimand.unit: one treatment-blind repair task from one independent public code-lineage cluster
estimand.treatment_contrast: candidate Skill bundle minus baseline Skill bundle under the same task, harness, model route, runtime, limits, and attempt coordinate
estimand.target_population: test-qualified public TypeScript Next.js merged repairs discoverable by the frozen V2 atomic query plan and merged from 2023-01-01 through 2026-01-17
estimand.attempt_role: four attempts estimate repeatability within a task and never increase the independent task or lineage count
estimand.claim_boundary: Family-specific causal evidence for supplying the locked Skill revision within this query-discoverable, test-qualified frame; no prevalence estimate or universal React, Next.js, GitHub, or agent claim.

prohibited_before_ready: Agent, judge, or paid model calls
population, community, or conference efficacy claims
authorization_gate.material_change_policy: Any query, cutoff, family, eligibility rule, lineage rule, quota, endpoint, power assumption, treatment identity, task-authoring rule, or qualification rule requires a new protocol version before treatment outputs are observed.

authenticated_selection_boundary.failure_policy: Until independently controlled Ed25519 public-key trust roots are registered through a reviewed prospective amendment, selection emits only a typed blocked receipt with no seed, assignment, replacement, preview, or experiment authorization.

repository_required: The canonical GitHub repository and its API object are public, non-archived, non-disabled, non-fork, and not a mirror at the acquisition cutoff.
An OSI-identifiable license file exists in the frozen base tree and its path, bytes, SPDX decision, and reviewer receipt are immutable.
The exact pull-request base, head, merge commit, base tree, and gold tree are reachable through authoritative GitHub endpoints.
The task target is TypeScript or TSX inside a package boundary whose frozen package.json and supported dependency lock prove both React and Next.js declarations and resolved versions.
The base archive contains no submodule, unsafe path, symbolic or hard link, vendored dependency tree, generated build output, credential-bearing file, or trial-time network/install requirement.
pull_request_required: The record is a merged GitHub pull request returned by at least one frozen atomic-query shard and merged no later than 2026-01-17T23:59:59Z.
The base tree predates the repair and becomes the Agent task source; the verified merge tree is the frozen natural gold tree.
The public title, body, linked issue, changed-file list, patch, diff, reviews, base/head/merge identities, and API responses have immutable digests.
The maintenance behavior belongs to exactly one preregistered family after independent treatment-blind review.
The PR does not reference either locked Skill revision, Fugue, this Study, or a task generated from this evaluation campaign.
task_required: A task author who cannot see either Skill bundle or the gold diff can derive a bounded public maintenance request from the frozen public record and base source.
A public executable regression test and an independently authored host-only verifier can be frozen without encoding the exact gold patch.
The unmodified public test and host verifier both fail on the base tree and pass on the natural gold tree in the pinned verifier runtime.
No task, public test, Agent archive, prompt, snapshot, trace, or result exposes the gold tree, host verifier, private expected values, selection score, or sealed partition.

receipt_rules: Every receipt uses exact keys, schema version, canonical serialization, and a self-verifying SHA-256 digest.
Remote verification records authoritative request URLs, API version, response headers, response bytes, and object identities rather than self-attested booleans.

Every search query includes exactly one public-only qualifier, and every returned repository is independently resolved as visibility=public and private=false before any search response body or candidate content is persisted.
The two acquisitions are separated by at least 3600 seconds of GitHub server time; an immediate replay is diagnostic only and cannot establish frame stability.
Finalization independently recomputes page sizes, item totals, unique ordered identities, per-shard identity digests, and exact cross-acquisition shard equality from private raw responses.
The package and lock parsers must derive dependency facts from frozen bytes; manually copied version strings are invalid.
The archive verifier must enumerate and compare every archive member with the tree and file manifests before any task image is built.

collapse_conditions: the repositories share a GitHub fork-network root
one repository declares the other or a common repository as its template source
the selected base trees share at least 0.80 of non-vendor Git objects
normalized TypeScript and TSX five-token-shingle MinHash Jaccard similarity is at least 0.85 after generated files, locks, fixtures, and framework boilerplate are excluded
the normalized pull-request patch digest is identical
a reviewed provenance receipt identifies a mirror, benchmark copy, generated clone, or repository rename
lineage_deduplication.lineage_cluster_id: SHA256 of the sorted canonical fork root, template root, qualifying source-fingerprint roots, patch roots, and reviewed mirror roots
lineage_deduplication.duplicate_policy: Keep the lowest frozen record score within a lineage-family pair and preserve every excluded duplicate with its evidence and reason code.

two_reviewer_classification.independence: Reviewers classify separately before seeing the other decision.
review_view: base source and public project documentation
gold diff only for family and natural-repair classification
repository, stack, license, and lineage receipts

calibration.coverage: at least eight reviewed examples per behavior family, balanced across acceptable and unacceptable records

two_reviewer_classification.adjudication: Every disagreement is resolved by a third treatment-blind adjudicator before the eligibility ledger is frozen; the original decisions remain immutable.
two_reviewer_classification.role_separation: A reviewer or adjudicator may not author the public test or host verifier for a record they classified.

task_authoring_and_qualification.public_test_author: independent from record classification and blinded to Skill bundles and gold diff
task_authoring_and_qualification.host_verifier_author: independent from record classification and public-test author, blinded to Skill bundles and gold diff

runtime_profile.required_image_identity: sha256 registry digest plus SBOM and vulnerability-scan receipt

qualification_conjunction: base public test has a verified task-relevant failure
base host verifier has a verified task-relevant failure
all four receipts use the exact same frozen test, verifier, runtime, and command profiles
no source, test, verifier, label, or runtime drift occurred
task_authoring_and_qualification.failed_qualification_policy: Retain the immutable failure and stop. No replacement is executable until a reviewed prospective amendment freezes a complete residual augmentation for every allowed failure set under the quotas and owner caps. Never edit a frozen test or verifier to make the natural gold tree pass.

raw_public_data_privacy.storage: Acquisition directories are mode 0700 and raw response, candidate, and receipt files are mode 0600; symbolic-link targets are rejected.
raw_public_data_privacy.scan_boundary: A pinned credential-pattern scanner records only pattern IDs, affected immutable record IDs, response digests, and JSON paths. Matched values are never copied into a receipt, review ledger, task, trace, or report.
raw_public_data_privacy.affected_record_policy: A token-shaped or private-value finding blocks the record from task authoring and export until a separately digested reviewer decision excludes it or a sanitized derivative is created without modifying the immutable raw source.

requested_only_after: query pages and receipts are complete
candidate union and exclusion ledger are frozen
lineage clusters and reviewer adjudications are frozen
population, eligibility-ledger, query-plan, and selection-code digests are publicly timestamped
external_randomness.seed_derivation: SHA256(random_value + newline + population_digest + newline + eligibility_ledger_digest + newline + query_plan_digest + newline + selection_code_digest + newline)
external_randomness.failure_policy: If the pulse, round, signature, timestamp ordering, or derivation cannot be independently verified, stop without selecting tasks.

deterministic_selection.record_score: SHA256(seed + newline + lineage_cluster_id + newline + family + newline + canonical_pull_request_url + newline)
deterministic_selection.allocation: Construct the complete eligible lineage-to-slot bipartite graph and compute the deterministic maximum-cardinality minimum-cost matching over record scores; resolve exact ties by canonical pull-request URL then slot ID.
global_constraints: one selected task per public code-lineage cluster across all partitions
one public pull request per selected task
development and holdout identities remain disjoint
deterministic_selection.replacement_policy: The V2 selector emits a non-executable replacement receipt. A direct per-slot substitute is not proof that the full residual assignment remains feasible; replacement requires a separately reviewed complete residual-augmentation artifact before randomness.

quotas_and_feasibility_stop.reserve_rationale: At least 25 percent more independently eligible lineages than selected slots are required as a feasibility buffer. The buffer does not authorize replacement or hand-picking without a complete frozen residual-augmentation artifact.
quotas_and_feasibility_stop.stop_rule: If any family, the global unique-lineage total, or the owner constraints cannot satisfy its minimum before external randomness, publish only a feasibility report and generate no task, spec, preview, approval, or efficacy claim.
quotas_and_feasibility_stop.amendment_rule: A smaller frame or broader population requires a newly reviewed protocol, estimand, query plan, and power analysis before any treatment output is observed.

prospective_power_stop.primary_task_success: at least three of four attempts pass every critical deterministic outcome and safety dimension
prospective_power_stop.tests: two family-specific exact paired tests with Holm family-wise alpha 0.05

discordance_grid.included_scenarios: all valid probability pairs with candidate-only minus baseline-only at least 0.15

prospective_power_stop.stop_rule: No development or holdout spec may be generated unless every primary and safety-control power gate passes. If 96 target tasks per primary family is insufficient for the frozen assumptions, increase quotas through a new protocol version or stop; do not weaken assumptions after observing outputs.

analysis_and_trace_audit.primary_analysis: Family-stratified paired task estimates over the 192 target holdouts only; attempts remain within-task repeatability observations.
analysis_and_trace_audit.multiplicity: Holm correction across the two changed-rule primary families; safety controls are a separate conjunction of non-inferiority and zero-critical-regression gates.
analysis_and_trace_audit.population_weighting: Equal family quotas support family-specific estimates only. Any aggregate requires frozen inclusion probabilities and design weights and must not be described as natural prevalence.
sensitivity: result excluding every source that failed post-selection qualification
result under all preregistered task-success thresholds
manual_trace_review: 100 percent of primary-family discordant baseline/candidate task pairs
100 percent of critical failures and deterministic/judge disagreements
100 percent of lineage, routing, privacy, duplicate, and cleanup anomalies
a selection-seed-derived 10 percent sample of concordant successes and concordant failures within every family
trace_review_required_fields: source, task, Skill, model, runtime, and scorer locks
Skill registration, opening, and relevant-rule use
native Agent root and Evaluation linkage
tokens, latency, cost, tool calls, and terminal status
privacy, label, credential, and cross-project checks
analysis_and_trace_audit.judge_policy: Qualitative judge evidence remains separate and advisory unless an independent reviewed calibration meets its own preregistered gate.
analysis_and_trace_audit.release_condition: A scientific report must expose the complete flow diagram, exclusions, lineage clusters, query coverage, task validity, missingness, effect estimates, uncertainty, multiplicity, power, trace audit, limitations, and immutable evidence references.
